input_messages.content:
Hi! I actually need some help with my account and a couple of recent orders. I just moved to a new house, but it’s still on Elm Avenue here in Houston. I noticed that one of my orders was sent to my old address, and I’d like to have it updated to my new place. Also, can you update my default address in your system to the new one? I’d prefer if you could look up the details using my orders, since I don’t want to share my address directly. 

And after that, I’d like to talk about exchanging the tablet I just bought for a less expensive model, since moving has been a bit costly.

Sure! My name is Sophia Martin and my email is sophia.martin4832@example.com. I’d prefer not to share my zip code, but you should be able to find my orders and addresses with this information. Let me know if you need anything else to verify my account.

Yes, please go ahead and update the shipping address for order #W1092119 to my new address, and also set my default address to the new one.

As for the tablet exchange, I’m not sure about the specific models. Could you let me know which is the cheapest tablet available right now? I’d like to exchange my current tablet for that one to help with my moving expenses.

Thank you for updating my addresses!

Yes, I’d like to go ahead and exchange my current tablet for the cheapest one you mentioned—the 8-inch, 128GB gold model. Since it’s less expensive, will the difference be refunded to my original payment method, or do I need to provide any additional info for the refund? Let me know what you need from me to complete the exchange.

Yes, I confirm that I want to exchange the tablet in order #W1603792 from the 7-inch, 32GB gold model to the 8-inch, 128GB gold model, and I agree to have the price difference refunded to my original payment method. That’s the only item I want to exchange in this order. Thank you for your help!
No, that covers everything for now. I’ll wait for the delivery and reach out again for the exchange once it arrives. Thanks for your help! ###STOP###
